caption:
Lulu squats deep on site and at the gym, and lately the front of the ankle feels jammed at the bottom.

The further the shin tips forward over the foot, the tighter the front of the ankle gets. An old sprain or a stiff ankle can make that pinch more likely.

Hybi's opener: knee to wall, heel down, just short of the pinch, 10 reps twice a day. For now, squat a bit shallower with the toes turned out slightly.

An ankle that swells, keeps giving way or isn't better after three weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🦘
